text:
Nadia R: Heads-up — multiple reviewers flagged PTO overlapping with calibration week. We should publish a backup reviewer / shift schedule rather than reshuffling the whole timeline. Thoughts?
Theo M: +1. Staggered reviewer windows could work: reviewers split into AM/PM pools by timezone, each pool covers a 12h handoff. Keeps calibration time intact.
Priya S: That sounds reasonable. Two asks: (1) make it opt-in for reviewers who prefer not to take overflow, (2) add a pairing system so each late submission gets two eyes (primary + backup).
Nadia R: Agree on opt-in. Proposal: add a column in reviewer sheet: "overflow ok? Y/N" and another column "backup reviewer". People Ops to auto-assign backups from volunteer pool sorted by capacity.
Theo M: For assigned backups, can we prioritize managers first to reduce context switching? Managers can triage quickly.
Priya S: Managers should be the last-resort backup—they often have conflicting meetings. Better: senior ICs with recent calibration experience. Also, set a soft cap of 6 extra forms per backup to avoid overload.
Nadia R: Good constraint. I'll set default cap = 6 and allow reviewers to request a higher cap. Also adding a short rubric for quick triage to speed backups.
Juno (HR Bot): Reminder: reviewer sheet link: https://redwoodhq/reviews. I can auto-fill backup assignments if People Ops provides the volunteer list by EOD.
Theo M: Can People Ops also publish an "urgent exception" flow for cases like LOA/new-hire ramp? Those should avoid overflow assignment and go to a dedicated escalation pool.
Nadia R: Will add an "exceptions" tag and create an escalation pool of 3 on-call reviewers (rotated weekly). They'll handle LOA/new-hire/critical roles.
Priya S: Timeline check: posting volunteer form today, assignments tomorrow morning, and calibration unchanged on Wed at 10:00 PT?
Nadia R: Yes — posting now. If we don't hit volunteer coverage by 09:00 PT tomorrow we'll auto-fill backups from the senior-IC roster and ping managers.
Theo M: Fine by eng. Please include a short FAQ in the announcement about how backups are chosen and how to opt out.
Nadia R: Will do. Draft announcement below, will post after 1 hour if no objections:

```
Quick update on reviewer coverage for calibration week:
- We are introducing an opt-in backup pool and AM/PM reviewer handoffs to cover reviewers on PTO.
- Action for reviewers: update the reviewer sheet with "overflow ok? Y/N" and preferred max extra forms (default = 6). Add a teammate as your preferred backup if desired.
- People Ops will auto-assign backups from volunteers; if volunteer coverage is insufficient by 09:00 PT tomorrow we will auto-fill from the senior-IC roster and notify affected managers.
- Exceptions (LOA, critical hires, new joiners) go to the escalation pool — please tag these on the form.
- Backup reviewers: you are asked to do a focused triage using the provided 5-minute rubric to keep throughput up.
Questions? Reply here or DM @Nadia R.
```

Priya S: No objections. Thanks for doing this.
Theo M: All good.
Juno (HR Bot): Volunteer form posted and calendar reminder created.
